headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 24, 2026**
article:
The Colorado Rockies secured a 5-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, with Tomoyuki Sugano earning the win after 5.1 innings of work. Brice Turang led the Brewers' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance. In other action, the Detroit Tigers edged the Kansas City Royals 2-1, with Tarik Skubal leading the Tigers' pitching effort with 7.1 innings pitched and 12 strikeouts. The Chicago Cubs took down the Pittsburgh Pirates 3-2, with Caleb Thielbar earning the win and Gavin Hollowell securing the save.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, with Rafael Flores Jr. of the Pittsburgh Pirates placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion. The move is retroactive to July 23, 2026. Other notable injuries include Brad Keller of the Philadelphia Phillies, who was transferred to the 60-day injured list with a right elbow UCL tear, and Patrick Corbin of the Toronto Blue Jays, who was placed on the 15-day injured list with a left teres major strain.

The Pittsburgh Pirates have made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Ron Marinaccio from the San Diego Padres in exchange for future considerations. The Chicago Cubs also made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for right-handed pitcher Aiden Moffett.
